The [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ken-Kiba]] maintained a '''base''' on the [[Telerath's second moon|second moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Telerath/Legends|Telerath]] for his [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-running operations. His spice refineries there were staffed by [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] [[Chubbit]]s and [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurians]], overseen by [[T'surr (species)|T'surri]] gang members. The operation was turned upside down when exiled [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Dass Jennir]] visited the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] and freed the gang's enslaved workforce.<ref name="DT14" />
